verdict.rationale: E2B documents its own code-execution API: `sbx.runCode()` runs Python inside a sandbox, and the docs pitch it for running AI-generated code to analyze data. The evidence only shows Python execution, though. Running other runtimes is not documented for runCode, and nothing describes the structure of the returned results. missing for 10: documented JavaScript and other language runtimes for code execution, documented rich result outputs (charts, tables, structured data), independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can execute code in multiple language runtimes (Python, JavaScript, and more) and get rich results back

citations.quote: We’ll write the minimal code for starting Sandbox, executing Python inside it and listing all files inside the root directory.
You can use E2B Sandbox to run AI-generated code to analyze data.
